Support

Frequently asked questions

My offer letter isn't showing yet — why?

Offer letters are available 24 hours after you submit your application. Check the "Applications on this device" table on the Home page for the countdown.

How do I get my completion certificate?

Finish the weekly training (videos, quiz, and final project) from the Training dashboard, then wait for admin approval. Once approved, both certificates appear in the applications table.

How can I verify someone's certificate?

Use the "Verify Certificate" tab and enter the App No printed on the certificate.

I switched devices and my application disappeared — what happened?

Applications are saved in your browser only. Sign in with the same Google account you used originally, or reapply from the new device.

I have another question.

Use the form below or email us directly — we usually reply within 1–2 working days.

Contact support

Opens your email app addressed to trendra.care.ac.in@gmail.com — just hit send there.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 28 September 2026

1. Information we collect

When you apply for an internship, we collect the details you submit: your name, college, mobile number, chosen track, start date, plan, and your GitHub/LinkedIn URLs. We also request your device's GPS location (latitude/longitude) at the time of application, with your explicit browser permission — you can decline this permission, but location is currently required to submit an application. If you sign in with Google, we read your name and email from your Google account.

2. How your data is stored

This portal runs entirely in your browser. Application data, training progress, and account details are stored in your browser's local storage on your own device — TrendraXTech does not run a central server or database. Your data is not automatically visible to us unless you email it to us or an admin views it on the same device/browser.

3. How we use your information

We use your details to generate your offer letter and certificates, track your training progress, and respond to support queries. Admins and instructors you're matched with may view your application and submissions to approve your certificate.

4. Third-party services

We use Google Sign-In for authentication. If enabled, we may use an email-delivery service (EmailJS) to send you your offer letter automatically. These services process your email address to provide their function and are governed by their own privacy policies.

5. Certificate verification

The "Verify Certificate" tool checks your Certificate ID (App No) only against applications stored on that specific browser/device. We do not currently maintain a central, cross-device verification database.

6. Your choices

You can clear your browser's local storage at any time to remove your locally-stored data. To request removal of any data you've shared with us by email, contact us using the details below.

7. Contact us

Advertising. This site may show ads served by Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites. You can manage personalised ads at adssettings.google.com.

For any privacy questions, email trendra.care.ac.in@gmail.com.
